title: Online Surveillance of Treatment of Children With Growth Hormone Deficiency With ZOMACTON
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate long-term treatment with Zomacton® for pituitary short stature in children with insufficient growth hormone production and/or short stature caused by Turner syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* therapeutic need according to SPC
* written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* contraindications according to SPC
